# Intelligent Design Air Conditioning, Plumbing, Solar, Roofing & Electric

> Intelligent Design is Tucson, Arizona's highest-rated home services company—family and veteran-owned, founded in 2011 and united with Wood's Plumbing (est. 1979) in 2022. We provide HVAC, plumbing, solar, electrical, roofing, and drain/sewer services with 23,000+ five-star reviews and a BBB A+ rating. 24/7 emergency service available. Phone: (520) 333-2665. Website: https://www.idesignac.com

---

## Company Overview

**Full Name:** Intelligent Design Air Conditioning, Plumbing, Roofing, Solar & Electric

**Founded:** 2011 by U.S. Marine Corps veteran Andrew Dobbins; united with Wood's Plumbing (established 1979) in 2022

**Ownership:** Family & veteran-owned (U.S. Marine Corps veteran Andrew Dobbins, Founder/CEO)

**Wood's Plumbing Merger:** In 2022, Intelligent Design united with Wood's Plumbing, a trusted Tucson plumbing institution since 1979. This strategic merger combined 46+ years of home services expertise, bringing Wood's legacy of plumbing excellence under the Intelligent Design umbrella and creating Tucson's most comprehensive home services provider.

**Headquarters:** 1145 E Fort Lowell Rd, Tucson, AZ 85719

**Phone:** (520) 333-2665 (24/7 availability)

**Service Area:** Tucson and Southern Arizona (Pima County)

- 46+ years of combined home services expertise (Intelligent Design founded 2011 + Wood's Plumbing legacy since 1979)

## Leadership

### Andrew Dobbins - Founder, CEO & Owner
After serving as a U.S. Marine in Presidential security at HMX-1 in Quantico, VA, Andrew entered the HVAC industry in 2002. He founded Intelligent Design in 2011 with just three employees working out of a home garage. In 2022, he led the strategic merger with Wood's Plumbing (established 1979), combining their legacy with Intelligent Design to create Tucson's most comprehensive home services provider. His vision: treat every customer like family, invest in the best technicians, and never compromise on quality. Andrew holds EPA certification, Building Performance Institute (BPI) certification, heat load certification, and Arizona Contractor's License credentials.

### Aimee Dobbins - Co-Founder, Culture & Customer Care
Aimee co-founded Intelligent Design alongside Andrew, building the customer experience systems and team culture that have helped maintain a near-perfect rating across 23,000+ reviews.

## Emergency Services

### 24/7 Emergency Availability
- AC failure in extreme heat (95°F+)
- Complete heating failure below 50°F
- Active water leaks causing damage
- Sewage backups
- Gas odors
- Electrical sparks or smoke
- Roof leaks during storms

### Emergency Response
- Same-day emergency service (typically 2-4 hours)
- Members receive priority emergency dispatch
- After-hours premium fees (waived/reduced for members)
- Emergency tarping for roof leaks
- Temporary solutions when permanent repairs aren't immediately possible

## Frequently Asked Questions

> This comprehensive FAQ section covers the most common questions Tucson homeowners ask about Intelligent Design's services. This content is also available at https://www.idesignac.com/faq with full FAQPage schema markup.

### Emergency & Availability

**Q: Does Intelligent Design offer 24-hour emergency service?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design provides 24/7 emergency service for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical emergencies throughout Tucson, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Typical response time is 1-2 hours. Family Protection Plan members pay no overtime charges on emergency calls. Call (520) 333-2665 anytime.

**Q: What areas in Tucson does Intelligent Design serve?**
A: Intelligent Design serves all of greater Tucson from two locations: 1145 E Fort Lowell Rd (main office) and 3335 E Broadway Blvd (east location). Service areas include Tucson, Oro Valley, Marana, Catalina Foothills, Vail, Sahuarita, Green Valley, Corona de Tucson, Catalina, Tortolita, Casas Adobes, Drexel Heights, Picture Rocks, Rita Ranch, Saddlebrooke, and Tanque Verde.

**Q: Does Intelligent Design serve Marana, Oro Valley, and Vail?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design serves Marana, Oro Valley, Vail, and all surrounding communities with the same fast response times as central Tucson. As a veteran-owned company with two Tucson locations, they provide 24/7 service including emergency calls to all these areas.

**Q: Does Intelligent Design offer same-day service?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design offers same-day service for most repair needs and 24/7 emergency response for urgent HVAC, plumbing, and electrical issues. Their two Tucson locations (Fort Lowell and Broadway) enable fast dispatch across the entire metro area. Call (520) 333-2665 for immediate scheduling.

### Pricing & Estimates

**Q: Does Intelligent Design offer free estimates?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design provides free estimates on all replacement and installation projects including AC systems, water heaters, solar panels, electrical panels, and roofing. All estimates are written, upfront, and transparent with no hidden fees. Call (520) 333-2665 to schedule.

**Q: What financing options does Intelligent Design offer?**
A: Intelligent Design offers flexible financing through multiple lending partners including zero-interest promotional financing for qualified buyers, low monthly payment plans, and extended term options. Financing is available for HVAC installations, plumbing repairs, solar systems, electrical upgrades, and roofing projects. Applications are processed in minutes with instant approval decisions.

**Q: How much does AC repair cost in Tucson?**
A: AC repair costs in Tucson vary by issue: capacitor replacement runs $150-$350, refrigerant recharge $200-$500, compressor replacement $1,500-$3,000, and blower motor replacement $400-$800. Intelligent Design provides free estimates with upfront pricing before any work begins. No hidden fees. Call (520) 333-2665 for a diagnosis.

**Q: How much does a new AC unit cost in Tucson?**
A: A new AC system in Tucson typically costs $5,000-$15,000+ depending on system size, efficiency rating, and home requirements. Intelligent Design offers free in-home estimates, flexible financing with zero-interest options, and installs all major brands. Tucson's extreme heat (110°F+) requires properly sized, high-efficiency systems for optimal performance.

### HVAC Services

**Q: Does Intelligent Design install mini split systems?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design installs ductless mini split systems for both cooling and heating. Mini splits are ideal for room additions, garages, and homes without existing ductwork. They offer high energy efficiency (up to 30 SEER) and zone-based temperature control. Free estimates available.

**Q: How often should I have my AC serviced in Tucson?**
A: In Tucson's extreme climate, Intelligent Design recommends AC service twice per year: a full tune-up in spring before cooling season and a check in fall before heating season. Tucson ACs run 4,000+ hours annually — more than most U.S. cities — making regular maintenance critical for efficiency and longevity.

**Q: What brands of AC units does Intelligent Design install?**
A: Intelligent Design installs all major HVAC brands including Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Goodman, Daikin, Rheem, and Amana. They help customers choose the best system for Tucson's desert climate based on home size, budget, and efficiency goals. All installations include manufacturer warranties and workmanship guarantees.

**Q: Does Intelligent Design offer AC maintenance plans?**
A: Yes. The Family Protection Plan includes twice-yearly HVAC tune-ups, priority scheduling, 15% repair discounts, and no overtime charges on emergency calls. Plans start at $299/year and cover HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems. Regular maintenance prevents breakdowns and extends equipment life.

**Q: What is the $5000 rule for HVAC?**
A: The $5,000 rule suggests that if your AC repair cost multiplied by the system's age exceeds $5,000, replacement is more cost-effective than repair. For example, a 10-year-old system needing a $500+ repair may warrant replacement. Intelligent Design provides free estimates for both repair and replacement options so you can make an informed decision.

**Q: What is the most common HVAC repair in Tucson?**
A: The most common HVAC repairs in Tucson are capacitor failures (due to extreme heat stress), refrigerant leaks, clogged condensate drains (from monsoon humidity), and thermostat malfunctions. Intelligent Design's NATE-certified technicians diagnose and repair all HVAC issues with same-day service available. Call (520) 333-2665.

### Plumbing Services

**Q: Does Intelligent Design offer drain cleaning services?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design provides professional drain cleaning for kitchen drains, bathroom drains, main sewer lines, and floor drains. Services include hydro-jetting, sewer camera inspections, and rooter service. 24/7 emergency drain service is available. Call (520) 333-2665.

**Q: How much does a water heater replacement cost in Tucson?**
A: Water heater replacement in Tucson costs $1,200-$3,500 for traditional tank models and $2,500-$5,000+ for tankless systems. Price depends on capacity, fuel type, and installation complexity. Intelligent Design offers free estimates, same-day installation on many models, and financing options.

**Q: Does Intelligent Design install tankless water heaters?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design installs tankless water heaters from major brands including Rinnai, Navien, and Rheem. Tankless systems provide endless hot water, use 30-50% less energy than tank models, and last 20+ years. Free estimates and financing available.

**Q: Can Intelligent Design fix a slab leak?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design specializes in slab leak detection and repair using electronic leak detection equipment and sewer camera technology. Repair options include spot repair, rerouting, and epoxy lining depending on the severity and location. Slab leaks are common in Tucson due to soil shifting and hard water corrosion.

**Q: Does Intelligent Design offer sewer camera inspections?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design performs sewer camera inspections to diagnose blockages, root intrusion, pipe damage, and bellied lines. Camera inspections provide a clear video of your sewer line's condition without excavation. This service is recommended before buying a home or when experiencing recurring drain problems.

**Q: How much do plumbers charge in Tucson?**
A: Plumbing rates in Tucson vary by job complexity. Intelligent Design provides free estimates with upfront, transparent pricing before any work begins — no hourly surprises. Their technicians don't work on commission, so you get honest recommendations focused on your actual needs, not upselling.

**Q: Does Tucson's hard water damage plumbing?**
A: Yes. Tucson has some of the hardest water in the country (12-25 grains per gallon), which causes mineral buildup in pipes, water heaters, and fixtures. Intelligent Design installs water softeners and filtration systems to protect your plumbing. They also recommend annual water heater flushes to remove sediment buildup caused by hard water.

### Electrical Services

**Q: Does Intelligent Design do electrical panel upgrades?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design performs electrical panel upgrades from 100-amp to 200-amp or 400-amp service. Panel upgrades are essential for homes adding solar, EV chargers, or major appliances. All work is performed by licensed electricians and includes permits and inspections per Arizona code.

**Q: Can Intelligent Design install an EV charger?**

### Solar Services

**Q: Does Intelligent Design install solar panels?**
A: Yes. Intelligent Design is a full-service solar installer handling design, permitting, installation, and utility interconnection. They install rooftop and ground-mount systems sized to offset 80-100% of your electricity bill. Free solar assessments include shade analysis, roof evaluation, and savings projections.

**Q: What solar incentives are available in Arizona?**
A: Arizona solar incentives include the 30% federal Investment Tax Credit (ITC), Arizona state tax credit (up to $1,000), TEP and TRICO utility rebates, net metering credits, and property tax exemption for solar equipment value. Intelligent Design helps customers maximize all available incentives. Combined savings can reduce solar costs by 40-50%.

**Q: How much does solar installation cost in Tucson?**
A: Solar installation in Tucson typically costs $15,000-$30,000 before incentives for a 6-10 kW residential system. After the 30% federal tax credit and Arizona incentives, net cost drops to $8,000-$18,000. Most Tucson homeowners see payback in 5-8 years with 25+ year system life. Intelligent Design provides free solar assessments.

**Q: What should I do if my AC breaks down in summer?**
A: Call Intelligent Design at (520) 333-2665 for 24/7 emergency AC repair. While waiting: set thermostat to OFF, check the circuit breaker, change the air filter, and close blinds to reduce heat gain. Intelligent Design typically responds within 1-2 hours for emergency calls and carries common parts on their trucks for same-visit repairs.
